ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 55:45 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels; high-intensity regions are centralized in the lobe interiors, while low-intensity pixels define the perimeter, notch, and transition zones.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white blobs occupy the medial sections of both lobes; extensive fine-grained black-to-white mottling occurs at the proximal and distal boundaries of these patches; a solid low-intensity black zone extends from the peduncle connection to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; calculated vertex angle of approximately 25 degrees; depth is deep and symmetrical relative to the central fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-serrations along the entire trailing boundary; amplitude increases significantly at the distal tips due to biological encrustations; medial segments near the notch exhibit lower-amplitude undulating patterns.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curve along the majority of the trailing edge, transitioning to a sharper upward curvature at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, medium-contrast pixel clusters (approximately 5-8 visible) located within the low-intensity black region surrounding the median notch; dense, high-relief light-colored clusters (barnacle colonies) at the far-left and far-right trailing edge vertices.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of sessile cirripedia (barnacles) on both distal tips, creating jagged, high-texture anomalies that disrupt the natural geometric flow of the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'spray' pattern of isolated dark pixels (mottling) clustered heavily along the interior leading edge of the high-intensity white regions.
